conclusion: The center offset is real and inherited from a visually tuned camera/TCP prior. The renderer uses that origin consistently; the previous correction restored session orientation but did not recalibrate center. A translation-only diagnostic candidate improves independent frames, with orientation unchanged. It is suitable for visual review, not promotion to physical/training calibration.

The fingertip detector is unreliable on this larger gripper, so pixel and roll are visual picks.
evidence_of_inherited_center_prior.session_exact_value: 2026-09-28: the flexiv wrist camera was RE-MOUNTED between recording SESSIONS (contiguous blocks of release episodes inside a task; tasks interleave with sessions), so ONE value per embodiment or per task is wrong. Measured on all 20,767 converted episodes: jaw-axis tilt in the wrist image (line through the two fingertips, + = right tip lower; 3 open-gripper frames per episode, strict dark-finger blob rules), piecewise constant per block, clusters -22.5 / -7 / +1 / +10 deg; wipe_the_whiteboard (the pass-13/14 clip, roll -16) reads +8.85. Rows below = ONE hypothesis: roll only. camera_in_eef(row) = pass-14 value @ Rz(8.85 - tilt_deg) about the camera's own optical axis, position and pitch unchanged (user approved the renders on align/press_the_button/classify_the_battery/block_store_in_box/put_the_toothpaste, camx_shared/[local account]/openneo_flexiv_wrist_roll_by_task_20260928). evidence_of_inherited_center_prior.implication: Pass14 intentionally shifted a different clip fingertip target +40px right; subsequent session correction changed roll only while translation and pitch stayed fixed. That visual prior is not a measured per-session center calibration.

origin_audit.TCP_definition: Converter takes source eef pose; bundled Flexiv eef_in_flange_xyz_wxyz=null, renderer T_eef_renderTCP has zero translation and Ry(-90deg). No accidental additional flange/TCP translation was found. Physical source TCP-to-fin contact relationship is not measured.
origin_audit.white_boxes: Primitive boxes are20x8x12mm display solids, centered10mm behind TCP along approach; their geometric centers project16-18px below their front endpoints. These boxes are not the shape/contact centers of the real curved tactile fins.
origin_audit.width_model: Primitive x coordinate stays0 as width changes. Visible silhouette midpoint moves~23.5px vertically between28mm and98mm recorded widths. A fixed rigid line cannot fit all opening states exactly. The upper silhouette extrema can move through linkage, fin shape, perspective, or changing contact; their midpoint is not proven to equal the physical TCP.

candidate.scope: One episode/session; holds out58mm and40mm openings and additional times, but repeated frames are not independent calibration configurations. 3-5px landmark uncertainty; physical contact acceptance metric is unavailable.

why_translation_not_unique_physical_cali.image_alternative: Changing assumed principal point by the fitted pixel shift produces nearly the same endpoint residual as changing optical translation. A gripper-local origin offset produces the same own-wrist projection as an equivalent camera translation. One wrist image stream with unknown actual fin geometry does not distinguish these causes.
why_translation_not_unique_physical_cali.focal_only: Changing focal length alone with centered principal point cannot move a near-central origin horizontally by45px while preserving the observed jaw separation.

opening_dependent_hypothesis.interpretation: Lower residual supports missing opening-dependent display geometry, but this is not measured hardware linkage and does not justify moving a physical TCP with width.

remaining: Measure optical intrinsics/distortion or obtain per-device calibration.
Obtain tactile fin geometry and establish the source TCP/contact landmark relationship.
Measure opening-dependent linkage/fin motion rather than moving the stored TCP to the silhouette midpoint.
Check state/image timing around fast closure: transition frames have larger residuals and were excluded from stable-width calibration metrics. No time shift was applied.
Validate additional episodes from the same physical session before generalizing the display candidate.
data_safety: No canonical/training source, ALOHA, live gallery, or repository configuration changed. Scratch diagnostic script and artifacts only.
